series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description:
This issue contains two stories - Operation: Lady Doomsday and Hot Potato.

Operation: Lady Doomsday - The Joes are sent in to rescue Dr. Adele Burkhart from the clutches of COBRA before her secrets are revealed.

Hot Potato - Scarlett, Snake-Eyes and Rock 'N Roll are tasked with getting a tape containing sensitive information out of Colonel Sharif's tightly controlled emirate.

Full Summary

Operation: Lady Doomsaday

The story starts off with on a train in the middle of New York City and Washington DC, where a woman, named Dr. Adele Burkhart, is holding a press conference in one of the rooms. Dr. Burkhart is in charge of a nuclear weapons program. In the next shot, a group of terrorists, known as COBRA skydive and attack the train. A couple of reporters reveal themselves as COBRA operatives and had used the cameras as guns. One of the operatives, named Baroness take Dr. Burkhart into a helicopter.

In the Pentagon, General Flagg and General Austin discuss on how to rescue Dr. Burkhart before she reveals her secrets to COBRA. Flagg considers a counter terrorist group named the G.I. Joe. Austin pulls up the records of all the members and heads on down to their headquarters. Austin begins briefing the members on the operation.

At the COBRA Island, the COBRA Commander begins to taunt Dr. Burkhart. A COBRA operative notices and alerts the Commander of an incoming force. COBRA immediately deploys a force to counter the incoming squad of Joes. The G.I. Joe also notices the COBRA squad on the beach and they send Stalker in. Stalker nearly wipes out the COBRA forces on the beach. The rest of the Joes reach the beach and begin mapping their targets.

Meanwhile, at COBRA HQ, COBRA Commander and Baroness begin arguing on how they should counter the G.I. Joe. Baroness argues that they should execute Dr. Burkhart and send in teams to eliminate them, while COBRA Commander insists that the should let them come and try and take Dr. Burkhart.

Behind the COBRA Radar site, Breaker and Flash tap into their radar sites. Back at the HQ, Scarlett and Snake Eyes discover Dr. Burkhart tied to a chair. Scarlett begins on contemplating on shooting Dr. Burkhart, but back outs of it. Later on at the airfield, Grunt, Stalker, and Short-Eyes prepare for their assault at the airfield. Meanwhile at the Pentagon, Flagg and Austin begin the movement of a second force, armed with armored vehicles that will be deployed to combat the COBRA forces. Back at the airfield, Short-Eyes fires a mortar onto the airstrip, destroying a couple of planes. Grunt and Stalker begin laying fire onto the remaining planes, destroying the airstrip in the process. Grunt comments on how easy it was. A COBRA operative radios in that the intruders had destroyed the dummy planes.

Scarlett and Snake Eyes begin taking out some of the guards at the HQ, while Breaker and Flash run into Grunt, Stalker and Short-Eyes. Baroness begins to argue that they should execute Dr. Burkhart, as the Joes have already destroyed the airstrip. COBRA Commander reassures her that is plan is going out fine. A COBRA operative informs the Commander that another force of Joes has landed on the beach.

The second force of Joes begin destroying many of COBRA forces. Meanwhile, Snake Eyes and Scarlett take out the main generator. One of the COBRA members notices and orders Baroness to take Dr. Burkhart to take her to the airfield. At the fishing village, Flash, Breaker, Stalker, Grunt and Short-Eyes discover the dead bodies of the villagers. Later on, the second force of Joes destroy three tanks and a large amount of soldiers. Stalker ambushes a COBRA squad that was escorting Dr. Burkhart. He takes her from the wreckage and discovers that it was Baroness in disguise.

Back in the COBRA HQ, COBRA Commander assures Dr. Burkhart that his plan is going accordingly. Nearby, a COBRA soldier destroys the Joes tank, forcing the Joes to abandon it. Back at HQ, Scarlett and Snake Eyes fight their way through the HQ and discover Dr. Burkhart being held by COBRA Commander. COBRA Commander holds her hostage, forcing Scarlett and Snake Eyes to drop their weapons. The other Joes have a firefight with COBRA forces and begin to wonder where the Scarlett and Snake Eyes are.

Meanwhile, COBRA Commander tells the two that they will wait five minutes for the steel door to open, until Dr. Burkhart reveals that it's a trap. He attempts to shoot Snake Eyes, but Dr. Burkhart prevents it from happening. Scarlett reveals some ninja stars underneath her sleave and throws it at the COBRA Commander, injuring him in the process. The rest of the Joes blast the door open and find Dr. Burkhart wounded. She thanks them for their efforts and they take her to a helicopter. The Joes later find out that COBRA Commander had escaped through the a hidden passage way. They realize it's too late to chase them and go into the chopper. Right after they take off, the HQ explodes, destroying the Joes vehicles in the process. The chopper flies away, while Baroness and COBRA Commander escape through another plane and decide to rest until later on.

Hot Potato:

In a Middle Eastern village, Clutch, Stalker and General Hawk discuss plans on the capture of Colonel Sharif, a leader of a terrorist group known as Guardians of Paradise. The mission was to extract a tape that had information on Colonel Sharif. Meanwhile, in the desert, Snake Eyes, Rock N Roll and Scarlett have recently finished a firefight and were informed that another force of soldiers were coming their way. Scarlett was shot in the leg and is forced to stay behind while Snake Eyes and Rock N Roll to deliver the tape. The two begin running until Rock N Roll had lost Snake Eyes.

Scarlett is able to hold off the soldiers until two of them come from behind. They tried to throw a grenade until someone shoots them from behind. Snake Eye appears and reinforces Scarlett. Back at the village, someone throws an object at Clutch, Stalker and Hawk, making them to think it was grenade. They realize it was the tape they were looking for. They notice Rock N Roll driving back to the desert in his motorcycle. They realize that Scarlett and Snake Eyes were alive and need help.

Rock N Roll races to where Scarlett and Snake Eyes while another force of Sharif's forces rally. Sharif's soldiers begin charging at the two and hold them off through machine gun fire. They find Rock N Roll, where he eliminates a few targets. Scarlett and Snake Eyes hop into the motorcycle and drive away. Colonel Sharif orders an airstrike against the the three, where a fight jet is deployed. Just then, Hawk destroys the aircraft with anti aircraft artillery. Scarlett asks where the tape was, and he reveals it's with Stalker. On a plane, Stalker decides to order a hot potato.

description:
After escaping from the sunken bunker in Sierra Gordo, Snake Eyes and Dr. Venom find themselves captured by a contingent of Cobra Troops. Dr. Venom, as usual, tries everything to lie and cheat his way out of the situation. When it looks like his appeals have failed Kwinn, who was believed dead, emerges from the water and guns down the entire Cobra Troop.

The three uneasy allies make their way to an airfield and commandeer a plane. On the flight both Kwinn and Snake Eyes are subject to Dr. Venom's attempts to double cross them and kill them both. He fails in his attempts, but the two men spare his life believing that he will come in handy down the line. After crash landing their plane on a beach in Miami, Dr. Venom is picked up by representatives from Cobra while Snake Eyes and Kwinn are incarcerated.

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description:
In Trans-Carpathia, Storm Shadow leaps out of the window of a moving train crossing a river. He is detected on scanners by Dr. Mindbender who reports to Cobra Commander as Storm Shadow dives into the river and cuts open a sluice gate to enter the Silent Castle. Storm Shadow thinks he has found the captured Baroness and Billy but suddenly the room all around him turns into giant monstrous faces and hands as Cobra Commander leaps down, carrying giant weapons. The Commander boasts that Dr. Mindbender's Cyber Space Matrix is an environment which is designed to bungle the heightened senses of a ninja. Storm Shadow is unconvinced but is soon disorientated. Cobra Commander is wearing new powered body armour and soon overpowers the ex Cobra ninja.

In the Sierras, Snake-Eyes sits on a rock, so lost in thought that he doesn't notice a rattle snake approaching until Scarlett shoots it dead with her crossbow. She realises he knows Storm Shadow is in trouble and accepts that he must do what he must and go. In the Silent Castle Storm Shadow comes to strapped into the newest version of the Brainwave Scanner, together with Billy and the Baroness. Cobra Commander explains it can totally change a person's outlook and Dr. Mindbender activates the device. Slice and Dice are wondering if they are being made redundant by Mindbender's modifications to make the castle ninja proof and boast that Snake-Eyes will still get through so the Commander orders Dr. Mindbender to activate the matrix. The two Cobra ninjas find themselves standing on a tightrope over molten lava and also under attack from winged monsters looking like the Commander. They are soon restored to reality.

Three days later Flint and Lady Jaye drive through Trans-Carpathia, encountering two Cobra Destroyers. They take out one but the other is soon captured by the newly arrived Snake-Eyes. At the W-Lander Camp, Hawk and Stalker brief Snake-Eyes about the new technology in the castle. Snake-Eyes goes to the tent of General Liederkranz and takes many weapons, also removing his mask.

Later the surviving Cobra Destroyer returns to the Silent Castle with Snake-Eyes holding the crew hostage. He takes care of the guards and uses the Destroyer guns to blast into the castle. Inside he attacks the Cobra troops and defeats many of them. Mindbender reminds Cobra Commander that the latter is still wearing the new armour as they seek to lure Snake-Eyes into the matrix. Soon Snake-Eyes enters to confront Cobra Commander. But Snake-Eyes is not disorientated at all and throws a smoke grenade which interferes with the holographic lasers. He then smashes the control panels and shoots at Cobra Commander's armour. He fires a round containing white phosphorous at the armour which ignites on contact, burning out the power circuits. Cobra troops arrive but are soon disposed of. Snake-Eyes turns to deal with Cobra Commander but the latter is doused by Dr. Mindbender. Suddenly Snake-Eyes finds himself face to face with Billy, the Baroness and Storm Shadow - all now brainwashed and loyal to Cobra! Cobra Commander orders them to kill.

description:
Full Summary

Plot:

A research station in Alaska was raided by an unknown group, with all of the personnel killed and all of it's data stolen. The colonel deployed at the station suspects it to be an attack by the Russians, while General Flagg dismisses the idea, fearing another conflict with them. General Austin decides to send 4 members, who are currently on leave, to check out the Russian research station.

Stalker is the first one pulled out of his leave, while trying to hunt a deer. Breaker is next, receiving a message from a computer from M.I.T. Scarlett is then pulled out in the middle of a martial arts tournament. Snake-Eyes is last, being take out of his sensory deprivation unit. General Flagg flies them over to the Arctic, where he discusses the mission plan with them. He says they would have to observe the Russian station, while still trying to avoid contact with them. He also says that they should try and recover the missing records, but still focus on the main objective.

The team lands and hikes their way to the base. When they reach there, they set up a tent to camouflage themselves. They wait for about six hours, and then they notice an Eskimo come by with a dog sled. The team start to take in the fact that he has .30 Cal machine gun, and the fact he couldn't be that lost. The Eskimo goes inside the station and leaves quickly in a minute. Scarlett questions why he just left the door open, and Stalker wonders why he left the door to the station open. The team decides to go inside the base, where it reveals all the scientists froze to death. The team notices that some of the items in the base are missing. Snake-Eyes notices a bomb strapped under a table, and the team immediately leaves the station before it blows up.

The team start to wonder where this Eskimo is from, and decide to chase down the Eskimo on foot. Later on, General Flagg gets some data off of the Eskimo. His name is Kwinn and works as a Freelance Special Ops Enforcer. The team decides to continue tracking Kwinn. 5 hours later, they find Kwinn. They decide to sneak up on him. When they take off his covers, it reveals to be a pack of C4, and Kwinn comes out with the detonators. He threatens them to drop their weapons.

She met Snake Eyes while she was training the guys in hand to hand combat. She took the recruits down and to save face and her dignity, Snake Eyes let her throw him and she sensed that. G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description: The Joes have just completed a mission in which several Cobra personnel were captured and a large robot in pieces were seized. General Flagg ordered the robot to be taken to G.I. Joe headquarters, The Pit, for examination and safeguarding. Once the robot arrives at the Pit, it is taken to one of the sub-levels and scanned for any signs of functionality, to which none is found. It is a trick though, as Cobra Commander used a chemical based delay to trigger reactivation of the robot, at which point it locks security entrances and begins rebuilding itself. The purpose of the robot is to help Cobra discover the location of the base, but in order to do so, the robot must make it to the upper level so that the homing beacon signal can be transmitted. The Joes are locked in various parts of the Pit and use different methods to break free and find out what sealed the security doors which trapped them in different parts of the Pit. As the robot nears the surface of the Pit where the homing beacon signal would be picked up by Cobra, the Joes manage to fool the robot into falling into an open hydraulic shaft causing it to fall six floors down again.

description: The Joe's travel to Sierra Gordo to rescue Dr. Adele Burkhart for a second time. They find some help with the local natives the Tucaro Indians. Elsewhere, Storm Shadow begins to train Cobra Commander's son Billy as a ninja.

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description:
The G.I. Joe team receives word that a private para-military unit known as "Strike First" is being funded by Cobra and they decide to investigate. Hawk and Grunt go under cover and join the militia as new recruits while Snake Eyes conducts covert surveillance on the camp.

The Joes have to purposely act out of shape and clumsy to try and throw off the trainers at the camp. After a very short amount of time the Joes realize that there is something wrong with the camp but while investigating they trip a silent alarm and their cover is blown. Grunt and Hawk hold their own in a massive brawl but are eventually overpowered. Just before they are executed though, Snake Eyes saves them and lets them know that the leader of the camp has launched a plane with a nuclear warhead aboard and is planning World War 3.

Hawk steals a plane and intercepts the bomber, while the rest of the Joes take the camp. In his final moments the leader of the camp sets the detonator on a nuclear weapon buried beneath the base. It comes down to the final seconds for Zap, the Joes demolition man, to defuse the weapon and stop the detonation.

description: Stalker and Snake-Eyes run into their old friend, Wade Collins, who was in their unit in Vietnam. He's now a Crimson Guard, and he's got the two at gunpoint. Meanwhile, the Soft Master crosses paths with Billy Kessler near Springfield.

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description: Desert maneuvers turn into a no-quarter given firefight between the newest members of G.I. Joe (Heavy Metal, Crankcase, Bazook and Airtight) and Cobra's deadliest forces led by Destro, the Baroness and a new Cobra force leader!

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description: Two new Joes join the team. Snake-Eyes and Spirit are supposed to bring them on their first mission, but Snake-Eyes is distracted by a message from the Soft Master. Meanwhile, Ripcord ejects from a Sky-Striker above Cobra Island and proceeds on a mission of his own devising.

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description:
The issue opens with Zartan knocking out Rip-Cord and switching their identities for each others'. He then escapes Cobra Island, aided by the Joes, as a wounded Rip-Cord imposter.

The Joe's launch a covert invasion by sea on Cobra Island. Meanwhile, Storm Shadow and Snake-Eyes have landed in a Cobra warplane on the Island and quickly start killing Cobra Soldiers in their bid to find and kill Zartan! Storm Shadow has learned that Zartan is responsible for the murder of "The Hard Master" -- the ninja master to Storm Shadow and Snake Eyes.

Within the Cobra Headquarters, Professor Appel discovers the injured Zartan in his care is actually Rip-Cord -- the Joe who has been dating his missing daughter; Candy. Assuming that Rip-Cord is the only one who can find Candy, and knowing that Storm Shadow has infiltrated Cobra HQ in search of Zartan, Professor Appel sneaks Rip-Cord off of the island in a remote controlled super plane. The plane is programmed to fly to Cobra's secret headquarters in Springfield.

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description:
Storm Shadow and Snake-Eyes attempt to make their escape while the chaos of battle rages on Cobra Island.

After a long and excellent battle Storm Shadow and Snake-Eyes are thrown into the sea after their stolen hydrofoil is attacked. Storm Shadow battle's two Cobra Eels before a pack of hungry sharks come to make things worse.

Meanwhile the wounded Zartan, disguised as wounded Rip-Cord tricks the Joe's into rescuing him off of Cobra Island. In the previous issue after winning a fight with Rip-Cord, Zartan assumes Rip-Cords identity. Then Zartan disguises Rip-Cord to look like himself.

Storm Shadow has come to Cobra Island for the sole purpose of killing Zartan since he has learned that Zartan killed "The Hard Master", Storm Shadow and Snake-Eyes ninja master. Snake-Eyes against Joe orders has vowed to help Storm Shadow.

Storm Shadow The End?!

Snake-Eyes is quickly rescued by the Joe's but Storm Shadow has drifted to far away. Against all odds he makes it to the shore, only to be shot dead -- in the head -- by The Baroness who proclaims "You have betrayed Cobra once too often! And I intend that you never betray us again!"

Best Cobra Commander Moment

Destro says to The Baroness that Dr. Mindbender "thinks more highly of himself than Major Bludd does!" At which point The Baroness proclaims she enjoys Major Bludd's poetry. Cobra Commander says "Poetry? That idiot Bludd thinks that Proust rhymes with Faust!"

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description:
Storm Shadow has been killed by The Baroness -- shot in the head. Dr. Mindbender has Storm Shadow's body taken away to use his DNA in upcoming genetic experiments.

Zartan, now fully recovered from his battle wounds and still disguised as Rip-Cord, attempts to escape from the Joe's infirmary at The Pit (GI Joe Headquarters). Using his chameleon powers he shape shifts, assuming the identity of differnt Joe's. Ultimately he is knocked-out by Sgt. Slaughter who makes his 1st appearance.

Mean while Rip-Cord, recovering from battle wounds and disguised as Zartan, attempts to track down his girlfriend, Candy.

JOE YEARBOOK #3!

description: Mainframe and new desert specialist Dusty set off on a mission in the Middle East. After crossing a desert they are to infiltrate a Cobra Terror Dome believed to be hid in an oil field. Once there, their task is to hack into one of the Terror Dome's computers and send the intel back to Fort Wadsworth. Meanwhile Cobra Commander takes a comatose Billy to a hidden lab where Fred VII, an expert in robotic prosthetics, tries to mend him back to health. While there, Cobra Commander finds an advanced suit of armor that makes him more dangerous than ever before.

series_title: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero
description: After testing a newly developed artillery weapon in Utah, the Joes set up a convoy to transport the weapon to Colorado. Meanwhile a quirky accountant/ tracker named Raptor hopes to prove himself to Cobra Commander by tracking down the Joes through traced payment records linked to a believed base in Colorado. With the help of his trained hawks, Raptor locates the Joes and a Cobra Commander led attack follows.

description: Hawk has been taken to a missile silo that is being guarded by Law & Order, Lt. Falcon, Chuckles and Fast Draw. The one problem, they have been told they are part of GI Joe, which they aren't. Dreadnoks lead by Zarana attack the missile and a battle erupts between them. It turns out the missile is set to destroy Cobra island. Buzzer saves the day by bringing in an attack chopper that demolishes the weapon.  At the end of the battle, Hawk grants all four of them official membership into GI Joe.

They discover that the journalist has already been released after they raid the prison. As they fight their way out, Snow Job and Quick Kick are injured. Stalker then orders Outback to leave them behind. Billy turns his back on his father. Cobra Commander then turns his back on Fred VII, who shoots Cobra Commander.

Life in the gulag is hard for Stalker, but at least Snow Job and Quick Kick's health has improved. Billy talks to Hawk, Storm Shadow and Rip Cord about the death of the Soft Master and Candy, but refuses to betray anything about his father. Fred VII charters a boat to Cobra Island.

issue_title: Captain Marvel Battles the Discarded Instincts; Captain Marvel Battles the Unknown Danger; Captain Marvel and the Strange Time Circus
description: A box is opened and humanity’s long-discarded bad instincts are accidentally released again into the world. Will the World’s Mightiest Mortal’s instinct to help other people prove stronger?

issue_title: The Return of the Ancient Villain; The Ice World; The Dilemma of the Double Identity; The Self-Made Hero; Mechanical Man Mystery
description: The World’s Mightiest Mortal is staggered as he battles the ancient enemy of the whole human race in “Captain Marvel and the Return of the Ancient Villain.” And one Dr. Sivana is bad enough, but two Dr. Sivanas? Holy moly! In “The Dilemma of the Double Identity.”

issue_title: The Great Heat Age!; Mr. Tawny's Fight for Fame
description: Billy Batson investigates a report of a farm being flooded by tar in “Captain Marvel and the Creeping Horror.” Plus our hero travels to 30,000 BC in “Captain Marvel the Great Heat Age!” and Tawky Tawny seeks the cheers and acclaim of others in “Mr. Tawny’s Fight for Fame.”

issue_title: Sivana's Voodoo Curse; The Mystery of the Expanding Island; The Man Who Grew Young
description: Three action-packed adventures with the World’s Mightiest Mortal: Captain Marvel battles “Sivana’s Vodoo Curse,” investigates “The Mystery of the Expanding Island,” and restores “The Man Who Grew Young”!

issue_title: The Crystal Catastrophe; Mr. Tawny's Pleasure Peril; The House That Didn't Want To Be Haunted
description: Mr. Tawky Tawny, the civilized tiger, learns that all play and no work isn’t as fun as it sounds, and only Captain Marvel can save him from “Mr. Tawny’s Pleasure Peril.” Plus, two other adventures of the original Captain Marvel as he investigates “The House That Didn’t Want to Be Haunted” and battles “The Crystal Catastrophe.”

issue_title: The Liquid Horror; The Will To Satisfy; The Robot Hunt; Captain Marvel and the Curse of the Black Thumb
description: The World’s Mightiest Mortal gets the world’s mightiest surprise when he meets Doc Quartz’s Mechanical Monster in “Captain Marvel and the Robot Hunt,” and the Beastman returns in “Captain Marvel and the Liquid Horror.” Also features “Captain Marvel and the Curse of the Black Thumb.”
